description: Original Neofetch 7.1.0 runs through offline nix shell after automatic first-boot Nix database registration; launched by Sway IPC with a login shell.
provenance_note: Operator-declared metadata does not prove that footage shows a real touch.

site_assets.video_transform: 180 degree rotation and full-to-limited range conversion; original camera clip retained
site_assets.screenshot_source: grim on the physical board, transferred over serial

review.video_probe: H.264, yuv420p, limited range, 1920x1080, 30 fps, 24.000 seconds, 720 frames
review.visual_review: Reviewed camera frames near 1, 9, 18, and 23 seconds: the terminal and final Neofetch output are visible on the panel. Camera glare and the oblique view soften text; the native screenshot is legible.
review.interaction_state: Neofetch was launched through Sway IPC and a login shell after automatic Nix database registration; no touch launch is claimed. Camera proves panel display, not real finger touch.
